description: Replace a track's song credits with this list. Every track needs at least one songwriter, one performer and one producer before its release can be submitted. These are real people: ask the artist, and never invent a name to satisfy the requirement.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

credits.description: Each entry: name, role (songwriter | performer | producer). A performer also takes performer_type (primary | featured | non_featured, default primary) and instrument, which is REQUIRED for a performer: what they played or sang, spelled exactly as in get_requirements' `performer_roles` list (e.g. "Vocals - Lead Vocals"). Songwriters and producers take no instrument.

dry_run.description: True to check the call and see what it would replace, without writing anything.

name: set_track_credits
title: Credit who made a track
